currency_assumptions: Venue prices are stored in HKD (cost_local_amount / cost_local_currency = HKD). Every USD figure uses the ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27 and fetched 2026-11-28: EUR 1 = USD 1.0957 and EUR 1 = HKD 8.5774, giving USD 1 = HKD 7.828238 and 1 HKD = USD 0.12774267. See fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md for the worked cross rate and three hand recomputations.

Where a venue publishes an hourly rate, the recorded amount is that rate x 8 hours (the acceptable 09:00-17:00 window), stated in evidence.observed_facts. Where a venue publishes a day or session package, the recorded amount is that package and cost_rate_unit says which: 'day' for Igather Central's HK$10,000 full day, 'event' for the Sheung Wan Civic Centre lecture hall's HK$1,330 four-hour session. Packages therefore differ in length, so the USD figures are prices for each venue's own published package, not hour-for-hour comparisons.

Two venues publish a bare '$' with no currency marker. Dream Impact's Chinese-language Hong Kong page is read as HKD (its rates are plausible Hong Kong rates) and carries a confirm-currency question. Good Lab's page prints a bare '$' while its embedded Webflow currency setting declares USD, so its cost is left null with a confirm-currency question rather than converted.

Venues that publish no price at all (AMO, The Hive Kennedy Town, The Hive Wan Chai, Banyan Workspace, The Wave, Good Lab, PMQ, Hong Kong Science Park) carry estimated_cost_usd null with a cost_unknown question. Null is not free and is not a rejection.
No date is selected, ranked or recommended in this run. The whole 2027 calendar year was swept; the venue set is date-independent and every venue carries its own Saturday-availability question.

Alcohol is treated as a licensing question everywhere. No venue's page in this sweep states that an event alcohol licence or permission is in place, so every record carries a booking_terms question about serving alcohol and any licence requirement; no hotel bar is read as a yes.
open_questions: No date is selected, ranked or recommended in this run. The sweep covered the whole 2027 calendar year; no venue field, note or question in this package proposes a date.

Hong Kong school holidays are not asserted: the HK registry authority added on 2026-11-28 covers public holidays for 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31 only, and the school side is declared unknown in references/school_holidays.json.

Public-holiday context comes only from the HK registry rows: the seventeen gazetted 2027 general holidays are the only holiday dates this package recognises, and the registry prints 'Every Sunday' as a standing rule without expanding it into dated rows.

Fourteen of the sixteen venue candidates are on Hong Kong Island or in Kowloon East and Kowloon West; the New Territories are represented only by Hong Kong Science Park, and Cyberport could not be read (HTTP 403 to both curl and headless Chromium).

Eight Hong Kong venues publish no event-space rate at all, so half of the set cannot be compared on budget until quotes arrive. (Dream Impact is priced only under a currency assumption and is not counted among the unpriced.)

The 2027 calendar yield is announcement-limited: eight organiser-dated records, with several major Hong Kong events still unannounced (Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK 2027, Hong Kong AI Week 2027 has a month but no dates, HKTDC's 2027 fair calendar is bot-walled, and Digital Economy Summit, Wine & Dine and Clockenflap 2027 have no organiser dates).
Nothing here is a booking, a hold, or a partner commitment. Every contact route recorded for the community map is a public page, and no co-host relationship is claimed.

recommendation.rationale: Run A evidence package only. No venue is selected and no date is proposed; Joe decides both from the evidence. The scorer's tiers are recorded in venues.shortlist.json with the ECB-based USD costs.
